title: Toilet Paper Stand 26-Inch Solid Brass Freestanding Euro Style | Best Sellers Collection | Allied Brass
description:
When wall space is tight, keep toilet paper within reach with a freestanding toilet paper stand. This floor stand works as a toilet paper holder (also called a toilet tissue stand or toilet roll holder) placed right beside the toilet, and the European-style hook makes roll changes quick and easy.

Highlights:
- Add storage without wall mounting: freestanding floor design (not wall mount / wall-mounted / wall hanging)
- Stay stable in daily use: heavy base is designed to help prevent tipping
- Faster roll changes: European-style hook for quick replacement
- Coordinate a cohesive look: Best Sellers Collection styling pairs well with transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories
- Durable construction: crafted from solid brass (brass construction) with multiple designer finish options available

Specs & Details:
- Type: freestanding toilet paper stand / toilet tissue stand / toilet paper holder
- Material: solid brass
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 6.75 in x 26 in x 5.5 in
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 9 in x 9 in x 29 in
- Shipping weight: 6 lb
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Assembly: Assembled in the USA
